title: World Bloom — Break Down the Wall — Episode8 Carrying Those Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD continue their intensive training, set on surpassing RAD WEEKEND. But one day in the Street SEKAI, a new area suddenly appears: an unfamiliar plaza, in which stands a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link_street_op4
Street SEKAI
Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Darn...
Another dead end.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think all this walking around has given me a better understanding of this area.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
These alleyways all seem to extend outward from that central plaza.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And that wall is encircling it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I see...
So no matter which alley we go down, we'll hit a dead end.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's unfortunate.
I really want to see what's on the other side of this wall.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane and the others will likely need to surpass RAD WEEKEND for that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is how we see RAD WEEKEND.
This is what this wall represents...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's so big, tall...immovable.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Does that mean what lies beyond Nagi and her team's dream is waiting for us on the other side?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Beyond their dream...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (To stand on top of the world...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's such a huge goal, now that I think about it...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I mean, we've been having to work so hard just to win the events we're entering into now...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Even so... We have to find a way over this wall.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Because we won't get to see what's on the other side if we don't.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is something bothering you, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Sorry, I was just going over it all...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I knew it wouldn't be easy...
But I didn't think we'd have to face such a huge wall...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is a bit overwhelming when you see it right in front of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
However, I wouldn't worry.
I'm sure you'll all figure out a way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nagi, Ken, all the locals...
You're determined to carry all their dreams forward.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right.
We've already made our decision.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: There's no turning back for us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It doesn't matter how scary or unsettling things get... We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND no matter what.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
For the sake of our team.
For the sake of Nagi, her team, everyone...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've become such a strong girl...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But, don't forget about the others, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When someone's carrying a big load, it's easy for them to forget about those around them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They feel that they need to do everything themselves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
I may have felt that way for a second there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's not necessarily a bad thing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But everyone will always support you in any way they can when you get stuck.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Us as well, of course.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
She's right, Kohane!
I'll help you out in whatever ways I can!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll do my best to remember that we're all in this together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND!!
se_event_breakdown_2024_002

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
There's a crack in the wall...!
